description.zh-CN: 在 RPEN 中导入/编辑/导出 Milthm 自制谱（fmt=2），轨道式。v0.7.2：适配「多线编辑」的事件类型下拉——Milthm 谱面下按当前事件列映射显示语义通道名（线体/线头/整体不透明度、流速倍率、轨道大小、颜色、文字），隐藏无语义的着色器列；缩放列的多线编辑会并入唯一 Size(3) 通道。v0.7.1：模组启用后把 RPEN 全部文字换成随包 ChillRoundF（OFL-1.1，许可证随包）。v0.7.0：RPEN 特殊事件（线文本/判定线贴图）导出时转 Milthm 故事板。v0.6.9：修复预览旋转方向。v0.6.8：预览落速按 Milthm 完整公式组合。v0.6.7：预览判定头放大到音符大小。v0.6.6：全局流速（预览）设置。
description.en-US: Import/edit/export Milthm fan charts (fmt=2) in RPEN. Track-based: each judge line = one Milthm track. v0.7.2 adapts RPEN's multi-line edit event-type dropdown for Milthm charts: labels follow the current event-column mapping (per-channel transparency, flow speed, size, colour, text), the shader type is hidden, and scale-column edits are merged into the single Milthm Size(3) channel. v0.7.1 replaces all RPEN text with the bundled ChillRoundF font (SIL OFL-1.1, license shipped). v0.7.0 converts RPEN special events (line text / line textures) into Milthm storyboards on export.

description.en-US: Same value and meaning as RainPlayerUnity global FLOW_SPEED: 1.66 matches the player default and the preview falling speed follows this number (player slider range 0.8-2.4). Preview only; chart data and export stay unchanged.

description.zh-CN: 启用时用随模组分发的 ChillRoundF.ttf 覆盖 RPEN 文字：界面/按钮/下拉/输入框等所有 DOM 文本，以及所有用 RPE / RPEGame 字体族的画布文本（时间轴、预览文字、编号等）都会换成这个字体；关闭后恢复 RPEN 自带字体。（ChillRoundF 是第三方 OFL-1.1 字体，不是 PhiEdit 自带字体；许可证与版权声明随包。）
description.en-US: Overrides RPEN text with the bundled ChillRoundF.ttf: all DOM text (buttons, selects, inputs, textareas, kbd, code boxes) and all canvas text that uses the RPE / RPEGame families (timeline, preview text, line numbers). Disable to restore RPEN's own font. (ChillRoundF is a third-party OFL-1.1 font, not PhiEdit's bundled font; license and copyright notice ship with the package.)
